title: Compyla font lockfile
description: compyla.lock: pins each font family and style a project's templates use to the bytes that render them (architecture.md D14; markdown-spec.md §3, §10.3, C62). `compyla fonts sync` writes it; the CLI's font resolver reads it and returns the cached file named by each entry's SHA-256. A family and style appear at most once, families compared by their ASCII-lowercase form; entries are sorted by that form, by code point, then by style in the order regular, bold, italic, boldItalic. JSON Schema can't state the order or the uniqueness; the prose is normative.

family.description: The family as the template spells it.

source.description: Where `fonts sync` found the bytes: a user-supplied file, or Google Fonts. A font a docx template embeds is read from the template itself (§3), so it isn't pinned here. The bytes may be a metric-compatible substitute pinned under the template's family name.

from.description: The file path or URL the bytes came from, for people. The resolver reads only the digest.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the font file's bytes, in lower-case hex, which names the file in the cache.
